description: This is a C# source file defining a Blazor component named ToastComponent, responsible for displaying toast notifications with different levels such as Info, Success, Warning, and Error. It interacts with a ToastService to respond to show and hide events, and manages UI state accordingly.

classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: A Blazor component that displays toast notifications based on events from ToastService.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for showing and hiding toast notifications.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Displays the toast with message and styling based on the toast level.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Configures CSS classes and heading text based on the type of toast level.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Removes event handlers to prevent memory leaks.
